title: Unbound Performance
description: The ultimate client-side modpack. Features advanced NVIDIA optimization, enhanced privacy control, and cross-version server support.
body:
# Unbound Performance

**Unbound Performance** is a performance-focused client-side modpack meticulously optimized for modern Minecraft. This project aims to maximize frame rates, reduce stuttering, enhance user privacy, and allow seamless connections to legacy server versions—all without modifying core vanilla gameplay mechanics.

---

## ⚠️ Important Hardware Notice

* **NVIDIA Users:** This modpack includes **Nvidium** by default, which utilizes native NVIDIA hardware features for massive rendering distances.
* **AMD / Intel / Integrated Graphics Users:** Launching this modpack on non-NVIDIA hardware **will cause a crash on startup**. If you do not have an NVIDIA GPU, please open your instance's `mods` folder and delete the `nvidium` mod file. The pack will safely fall back to standard Sodium rendering.

---

## 🌟 Core Features

### 🚀 Performance & Rendering Optimization
Built on top of **Sodium** and **Lithium** for foundational rendering and logic performance. It integrates the **Nvidium** pipeline to deliver high-throughput frame generation on compatible GPU architectures. Combined with **Bobby**, the client efficiently caches extended chunk distances during multiplayer sessions to keep your frame rates stable.

### 🛡️ Enhanced Client Privacy & Control
Take control of your client's data and visual environment. The integration of **No Telemetry** and **No Chat Reports** helps prevent outbound tracking and centralized communication logging. Additionally, included client utilities allow users to manage or decline forced server-side resource pack downloads for a consistent visual experience.

### 🌐 Cross-Version Server Compatibility
Utilizing the **ViaFabricPlus** framework, your client is freed from standard version locks. This enables you to connect to a massive range of older server versions safely, from recent multiplayer updates down to classic Alpha and Beta releases.

### 🛠️ Quality-of-Life Toolset
* **Navigation:** Integrated **JourneyMap** for real-time world mapping and waypoint tracking.
* **Utility Overlays:** **Lighty** for analyzing block light levels, **Shulker Box Tooltip** for viewing nested inventories, and **AppleSkin** for accurate hunger and saturation HUD metrics.
* **Tools:** **Fabrishot** for capturing high-fidelity, uncompressed screenshots, and **Freecam** for safe client-side environmental inspection.

---

## ⚙️ Requirements & Technical Notes
* **Modpack Type:** 100% Client-side. It does not need to be installed on servers and is fully compatible with vanilla multiplayer networks.
* **Visuals:** Includes the clean and highly efficient **SalC1 Resource Pack** pre-configured for optimal UI clarity and lower rendering overhead.
